title: Colonialism and the Countryside: Exploring Official Archives

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the Company introduced the Permanent Settlement in 1793 and how it defined the zamindar's role.
Analyse why zamindars repeatedly failed to pay the fixed revenue demand in the early decades of the Permanent Settlement.

topics.title: The rise of the jotedars and the resistance of zamindars

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how jotedars consolidated their power in the villages and undermined zamindari authority.
Explain the strategies, such as fictitious sales, by which zamindars retained control of their estates.
Explain why and how the Fifth Report on the East India Company's administration came to be prepared in 1813.
Evaluate the limitations of the Fifth Report as evidence for the history of rural Bengal.

topics.title: The Paharias of the Rajmahal hills

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the forest-based livelihood and shifting cultivation of the Paharias.
Analyse the relations of the Paharias with plains people and the British, from raids to pacification.
Explain how and why the Santhals were settled in the Damin-i-Koh and how their settlements expanded.
Explain the causes and consequences of the Santhal Revolt of 1855-56.
Explain how Buchanan's surveys served the commercial interests of the East India Company.
Interpret Buchanan's descriptions to evaluate his idea of progress and its conflict with forest dwellers' lives.

topics.title: A revolt in the Bombay Deccan and the ryotwari system

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the course and pattern of the 1875 revolt of the Deccan ryots against sahukars.
Explain the ryotwari settlement and the Ricardian ideas behind it.
Explain how high revenue demand, falling prices and famine pushed Deccan peasants into debt.

topics.title: Cotton boom, credit crisis and the Deccan Riots Commission

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the American Civil War created a cotton boom in the Deccan and how credit dried up after it.
Analyse how moneylenders violated customary norms and used bonds and laws against the ryots.
Evaluate the Deccan Riots Commission report as an official source on peasant unrest.
